description: A React component for managing annotation layers in a data visualization application, including configuration UI, data fetching, validation, and applying annotation layers.

classes.name: AnnotationLayer
classes.description: A React component class for creating and editing annotation layers with UI controls and data fetching logic.

methods.name: componentDidMount
methods.description: Fetches applied annotation if needed after component mounts.

methods.name: componentDidUpdate
methods.description: Fetches slice data if conditions are met after component updates.

methods.name: getSupportedSourceTypes
methods.description: Returns list of source types supported for a given annotation type.

methods.name: shouldFetchAppliedAnnotation
methods.description: Determines if the annotation should be fetched based on current state.

methods.name: shouldFetchSliceData
methods.description: Checks if slice data needs to be fetched based on state changes.

methods.name: isValidFormulaAnnotation
methods.description: Validates if a formula annotation expression is valid.

methods.name: isValidForm
methods.description: Validates the form data before applying or submitting.

methods.name: handleAnnotationType
methods.description: Handles change in annotation type.

methods.name: handleAnnotationSourceType
methods.description: Handles change in annotation source type.

methods.name: handleSelectValue
methods.description: Handles selection of annotation value.

methods.name: handleTextValue
methods.description: Handles text input for annotation value.

methods.name: fetchNativeAnnotations
methods.description: Fetches native annotation layers from API.

methods.name: fetchCharts
methods.description: Fetches chart options from API.

methods.name: fetchOptions
methods.description: Fetches options based on source type.

methods.name: fetchSliceData
methods.description: Fetches slice data for a given chart ID.

methods.name: fetchAppliedChart
methods.description: Fetches and applies a chart annotation layer.

methods.name: fetchAppliedNativeAnnotation
methods.description: Fetches and applies a native annotation layer.

methods.name: fetchAppliedAnnotation
methods.description: Fetches and applies annotation layer based on source type.

methods.name: deleteAnnotation
methods.description: Removes the current annotation layer.

methods.name: applyAnnotation
methods.description: Validates and applies the current annotation configuration.

methods.name: submitAnnotation
methods.description: Submits the annotation and closes the editor.

methods.name: renderChartHeader
methods.description: Renders header for chart selection controls.

methods.name: renderValueConfiguration
methods.description: Renders UI for selecting annotation value.

methods.name: renderSliceConfiguration
methods.description: Renders UI for configuring slice-based annotations.

methods.name: renderDisplayConfiguration
methods.description: Renders UI for display options of annotation layer.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Main render method for the component UI.
